chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Ch. 359 – Lady Lan’s Price
chapter_meta_description: Han Li’s quiet negotiation at the Star Dust Pavilion reveals the hidden social games of cultivation commerce. A lesson in reading smiles and counting spirit stones.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 359: The Mask of Generosity
og_description: Han Li dissects a merchant’s polite lie in a battle of wits over pill formulas and top-grade artifacts.
twitter_description: No punches, just profit. Han Li climbs the social ladder of the Star Dust Pavilion one cold calculation at a time.

lore_anchors.definition: A soulless body reanimated through alchemical or necromantic arts, often retaining the muscle and bone density of its original form; a mana-bearing one is extremely rare and marks its owner as unusually wealthy or skilled.
A humanoid automaton animated by a spirit core or control talismans, used as a silent, tireless laborer or guard in the cultivation world.
A top-grade short blade forged from Mysterious Crystal and Ice Jade, imbued with a yin-cold aura that gradually drains an opponent’s combat effectiveness in prolonged battles.

The recipe for refining a Foundation Establishment Pill; in the Mortal Stream, possessing a formula is a long-term strategic asset far more valuable than a single pill, as it allows repeated production.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Lady Lan pretend not to count Fan's spirit stones?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She uses a hidden sweep of her divine sense to verify the amount instantly, then claims trust as a social performance to appear magnanimous and build goodwill.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn't Han Li show interest in the Cold Crystal Blade?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is not shopping for random single items; he has a specific strategic goal: pill formulas for his own cultivation path, or a large artifact set that offers more tactical flexibility.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the "sixth floor" qualification test?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A 1,000-spirit-stone minimum asset check, a common wealth-based access restriction in the cultivation world that filters out low-resource cultivators before high-value negotiations even begin.
